text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon claimed victory in the Japan 
Cup. Narita Brian was defeated, but after 
the race, she displayed a fierce, 
intimidating glare.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon declared that Narita Brian 
was the only one worthy of being her true 
one-on-one rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In Hishi Amazon's back, Narita Brian sees 
the shadow of her sister whom she had 
pursued for so long. She declared that she 
would not concede the next Arima Kinen.
